"""Kinematic grasp planning and object-pose feedback; output is only joint targets."""
import os, json, argparse
import numpy as np
import rcb_dtb, mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image

class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=rcb_dtb.Session('/app/instance.json');self.m=self.s.model; self.d=self.s.data
  self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m);self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  self.h=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id;self.o=self.m.body('object').id
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));self.jr=self.jp.copy()
  self.s.record_start()
 def pose(self,b=None):
  if b is None:b=self.h
  return self.d.xpos[b].copy(),self.d.xmat[b].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,p,rot,q=None):
  if q is None:q=self.s.targets[:7].copy()
  else:q=q.copy()
  for it in range(60):
   self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;self.k.qpos[self.s._jq[:7]]=q
   mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.k)
   err=np.r_[p-self.k.xpos[self.h], R.from_matrix(rot@self.k.xmat[self.h].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(err)<1e-6:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.h)
   J=np.vstack([self.jp[:,:7],self.jr[:,:7]])
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-6,err)
   q=np.clip(q+dq*min(1,.12/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-12)),self.s.lower[:7]+.001,self.s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def move(self,p,rot,hand=None,n=120):
  p0,r0=self.pose(); rr=R.from_matrix(rot@r0.T).as_rotvec()
  h0=self.s.targets[7:].copy();hand=h0 if hand is None else np.asarray(hand)
  for t in range(n):
   u=(t+1)/n; u=u*u*(3-2*u)
   q=self.ik(p0+(p-p0)*u,R.from_rotvec(u*rr).as_matrix()@r0)
   self.s.step(np.r_[q,h0+(hand-h0)*u])
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for _ in range(n): self.s.step(self.s.targets)
 def info(self,label):
  contacts=[]
  for co in self.d.contact:
   if self.o in self.m.geom_bodyid[[co.geom1,co.geom2]]:
    contacts.append((self.m.geom(co.geom1).name,self.m.geom(co.geom2).name,round(co.dist,4)))
  print(label,self.s.steps,self.s.progress(),'object',self.pose(self.o)[0].round(4),'palm',self.pose()[0].round(4),'contacts',contacts,flush=True)
 def snap(self,label):
  Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+label+'.png')
 def handfit(self,x=.055,z=.115,gap=.034):
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.k)
  hp=self.k.xpos[self.h].copy();hr=self.k.xmat[self.h].reshape(3,3).copy()
  hand=np.zeros(22)
  for f,ix,y in [('thumb',list(range(7,12)),-.02),('index',list(range(12,16)),-.0303),('middle',list(range(16,20)),-.01),('ring',list(range(20,24)),.0103),('pinky',list(range(25,29)),.0311)]:
   b=self.m.body('palmleft_'+f+'_DP').id
   target=np.array([x,y,z+(-gap/2 if f=='thumb' else gap/2)])
   ref=np.array([1,0,.8,0,.7] if f=='thumb' else [.3,0,1.4,1.])
   def fun(v):
    self.k.qpos[self.s._jq[ix]]=v;mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.k)
    pp=self.k.xpos[b]+self.k.xmat[b].reshape(3,3)@np.array([.021,-.006,0])
    return np.r_[100*((pp-hp)@hr-target),.05*(v-ref)]
   fit=least_squares(fun,ref,bounds=(self.s.lower[ix]+1e-6,self.s.upper[ix]-1e-6))
   hand[np.array(ix)-7]=fit.x
  return hand
 def grasp(self,args):
  self.hold(60)
  op,orr=self.pose(self.o)
  rot=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[-1,0,0.]])
  p=op+np.array([args.dx,args.z,args.x])
  opened=self.handfit(args.x,args.z,.085)
  closed=self.handfit(args.x,args.z,args.gap)
  self.move(p+np.array([0,0,.09]),rot,opened,180)
  self.info('pregrasp');self.snap('pregrasp')
  self.move(p,rot,opened,150);self.hold(30)
  self.info('approach');self.snap('approach')
  self.move(p,rot,closed,150);self.hold(60)
  self.info('closed');self.snap('closed')
  self.move(p+np.array([0,0,.12]),rot,None,180);self.hold(60)
  self.info('lift');self.snap('lift')
  return closed

def main():

 args=ap.parse_args();c=Controller();c.grasp(args)
 a=c.s.record_stop();c.s.save_trajectory(a,'/app/output/trial.npz')
if __name__=='__main__':main()
